Frequently asked questions

How do I activate my account?

Use the official administrator-provided registration payment instructions. Your account remains inactive until the payment is verified by an administrator. Do not pay an unverified person or enter an unverified code.

Is the KSh 200 registration fee refundable?

The stated VIEWPAY policy is that the KSh 200 registration fee is refundable and, once verified, is credited as the first account balance. Confirm the refund terms with the administrator before paying.

How are views calculated?

The stated rate is KSh 5 per view. Submitted views must be checked and approved before they become available balance.

When are payouts processed?

Payout processing days are Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Requests may require additional review.

Why is my proof pending?

Submitted screenshots and view counts require administrator verification. A submission does not automatically guarantee earnings.

Can I change my profile details?

Yes. Open Profile details, edit the fields and save your changes.

Terms and conditions

1. Account information

Members must provide accurate contact and profile information and keep their login credentials private.

2. Advert sharing

Members should share only official adverts supplied by VIEWPAY and follow WhatsApp's terms and applicable advertising rules. Do not spam, mislead viewers or use automated engagement.

3. Proof and earnings

The stated rate is KSh 5 per view. All submissions are subject to verification. Duplicate, altered or misleading screenshots may be rejected. Earnings are not guaranteed merely by submitting a claim.

4. Registration fee and activation

The stated registration fee is KSh 200, described by VIEWPAY as refundable and credited as the first balance after verification. Obtain and retain an official receipt and written refund terms before making payment.

5. Withdrawals

Withdrawal requests are subject to available approved balance, account verification and review. The stated processing days are Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

6. Privacy and security

Do not submit passwords, mobile-money PINs, card details or other secret credentials. A production service must publish a complete privacy policy explaining how personal data and screenshots are stored, accessed and deleted.

7. Demo limitation

If you have still haven't yet activated your account. You will have limitations on submitting status views and also requesting withdrawals. Remember activation fee paid is added to your account and you can withdrawal immediately after activating your account and your account will still be active.

Delete account

Deleting your demo account removes its locally stored profile, balance and activity from this browser.

For a live service, deletion should also remove or anonymize server-side personal data according to the published privacy policy and legal retention requirements.
